title: Yello Bingo Wizard Cat
description: A grey anthropomorphic cat wearing a purple and yellow striped wizard robe and hat sits on stone steps by the water, holding a scroll. In the background, three sailboats with lettered sails float on a purple sea under a golden and violet sky filled with floating glowing letters, with mountains in the distance.
prompt: A grey cat wizard with yellow eyes wearing a purple and yellow striped robe and pointed hat with a glowing halo sits on cracked stone steps at the edge of a mystical sea. The cat holds a glowing scroll. Three sailboats with lettered sails sail nearby on purple water. The dramatic sky blends orange and purple with many glowing alphabet letters floating in the air. Distant starry mountains in the background. Surreal fantasy scene with magical atmosphere.
